answer.summary: This procedure outputs a single protocol line to the system print file, including the program name, current time, and a text message. It acts as a no-op if the status parameter is zero.

rules.text: If the status parameter P#ST is equal to 0, the procedure returns immediately without writing any output.
If P#ST is not 0, the current system time is retrieved and the first 6 characters are extracted for the output line.
A line is written to the SYSPRINT file containing the program name, a space, the 6-character time substring, a space, and the text message, all formatted as alphanumeric fields.
